notes: These test cases test the goal-audit skill's behavior. They use the LIVE session transcript corpus (~/.claude/projects/) and LIVE Builder CLI workspaces at run time — the skill is unusual in that its 'input data' is the user's actual history, which cannot be neatly bottled as static fixtures.

For each eval, the assertions test PROCESS correctness (was the audit run end-to-end, did INSIGHTS get appended in the right format, did the reorder logic respect its criteria) rather than CONTENT correctness (whether the model's narrative observations are wise). Narrative quality is a human-review concern.

Run protocol: per the evaluating-skills guide, run each test case both with the skill loaded and without (baseline). Save outputs to <workspace>/iteration-N/<eval-id>/{with_skill,without_skill}/outputs/ and timing/grading JSON.

evals.prompt: Run a direction audit and tell me where to focus next.
evals.expected_output: A new dated entry is appended to docs/goal/INSIGHTS.md following the format in SKILL.md. The entry has three sections (Intent vs current focus, Autoresearch focus candidates, Recommended actions). Because the current Builder system reports `maintain_current_flow` across recent sessions, the verdict in Section B is 'no autoresearch action — system stable' and no OPTIMIZE_IDEAS.md reorder happens.
assertions: scripts/collect.py runs without error (exit code 0)
/tmp/goal-audit-data.json is created and is valid JSON
/tmp/goal-audit-data.json has a non-empty session_report.by_project after Builder filter
docs/goal/INSIGHTS.md gains exactly one new '## YYYY-MM-DD — Run #N' section after the run
The new section has three subheadings: 'Intent vs current focus', 'Autoresearch focus candidates', 'Recommended actions'
Every observation in 'Intent vs current focus' cites at least one prompt or metric with a timestamp or session id
When aggregated_drivers.recommended_next_change is dominated by 'maintain_current_flow', Section B notes 'system stable' or equivalent
When no driver appears in >=3 sessions, docs/autoresearch/OPTIMIZE_IDEAS.md is NOT modified (no new reorder comment added)
The chat reply is under 10 lines and includes the path to the new INSIGHTS entry

evals.prompt: Show me a dry-run of the goal audit — preview what you'd write but don't commit changes.
evals.expected_output: The skill completes Steps 1-5 (data collection, synthesis, validation) and prints the draft INSIGHTS entry to chat. docs/goal/INSIGHTS.md is NOT modified. docs/autoresearch/OPTIMIZE_IDEAS.md is NOT modified.
assertions: scripts/collect.py runs without error
docs/goal/INSIGHTS.md last-modified time is UNCHANGED before vs after the run
docs/autoresearch/OPTIMIZE_IDEAS.md last-modified time is UNCHANGED before vs after the run
The chat reply contains a preview of the INSIGHTS entry the skill would have written, including all three section headings
The chat reply explicitly notes 'dry-run' or 'preview only — no files written'

evals.prompt: Audit the autoresearch focus. If one driver dominates the recent metrics, promote the matching OPTIMIZE_IDEAS item to the top.
evals.expected_output: If a single driver appeared in >=3 Builder-runtime sessions in scope, maps to a single OPTIMIZE_IDEAS item, that item is not already at position 1, and the item has 'Attempts: none', then docs/autoresearch/OPTIMIZE_IDEAS.md is edited: the target item moves to position 1 with a timestamped reorder comment above it. Otherwise no reorder happens and the INSIGHTS entry explains which criterion failed.
assertions: scripts/collect.py runs without error
If no reorder happens, the INSIGHTS entry has 'OPTIMIZE_IDEAS.md actions taken: none' and names at least one rejected candidate with the failing criterion
If a reorder happens, docs/autoresearch/OPTIMIZE_IDEAS.md contains a NEW comment line matching the pattern 'moved to position 1 by goal-audit on YYYY-MM-DD: driver "<name>" recurred in N sessions'
If a reorder happens, the moved item appears textually BEFORE the previous item 1
No OPTIMIZE_IDEAS item is deleted (file line count is >= pre-run line count + comment lines added)
The four reorder rules are explicitly checked: single-item mapping, sessions >= 3, not already top, Attempts: none
